newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian shares recover losses, but seen nervous.
newsitem.headline: Belgian shares recover losses, but seen nervous.

text.p: 1530 GMT - Belgian shares rebound by the close in line with other European markets after the Dow Jones .DJI climbed sharply in the afternoon. Bourse to be quiet, nervous next week ahead of
* Bel-20 index .BFX finished just 1.64 points or 0.07 percent lower at 2,373.17 after falling earlier to 2,354.80.
* Solvay rises after recent big seller disappears, up 325 francs at 21,000.
* Colruyt down 175 francs at 17,300 after 1996/97 results and lack of fresh news on future of Dolmen unit disappointed the market.
